authority.cutoff: Closed R48 through R53 plus sealed CB1/CONTROL_CORES_LINK_V1 and completed R49/R52 diagnostics. All prior immutable refs remain historical.
authority.additional_import_and_producer_closure: Resolve actual observed small-source references of the admitted files/results to exact prior PH1-5 Git refs or new stable small sources; report missing/historical refs instead of inventing filenames or identities. Include R48-R53 analysis/report files matching their actual closed result provenance, not guessed names.
authority.results_scope: Only actual closed result/ERROR directories named by actual R48/R49/R50/R51/R52/R53 batch PROTOCOL case_names. Expected observed physical results13 and total182040 steps; independently reconcile from actual receipts, not this expectation.
authority.batch_scope: Only actual closed R48 through R53 batch PROTOCOL/results/abort/admission decisions. Unstarted R48/R49/R52 RM are DEFERRED, not robot failures.
exclude_explicit: all R54 and later cases, batches, reports, scripts and handoffs
active or later-mutating files not explicitly frozen above
giant original/derived robot assets and raw trajectories as payload
authority.H5_remains: 40/64, 24 guide failures, no retuning or rescoring; H1/H2/H4 and Stage1 V1 immutable
authority.qualification_boundaries: R53 flat nominal2/2 pass but RM0/2 with guide9/8; no clean firstflight rear-cross, no fullDR6cm/wholeRM/270/hardware qualification. CB1 pure candidate only, 9-core combination build/default smoke and ARM ET_REL partial only, no send transaction/BSP/WCET.
archive_constraints: Read current catalog and repo Git/archive policy; only own worktree, no expert worktree/index or main/ref writes.
SOURCE preparation only; do not run record helper, stage, commit, tag, or push until parent review and separate explicit approval.
Prefer exact prior Git SHA references for unchanged texts; keep failed attempts, unknown raw SHA, and one historical FSM source-version gap explicit.
Use producer SHA/size for raw and large assets; do not reread/hash raw or assets solely for archive and do not rerun any physical trajectory or old QA.
No GPU, new agents, environment/protection changes or goal mutation. No mtime-only blind recursive inclusion.
Resolve actual names and report guesses that do not exist; the allowlist is not evidence that any guessed producer script existed.

scope.root_admission: explicit cutoff patterns plus needed executed/provenance/import/loader closure; no mtime selection
scope.case_admission: actual protocol case_names plus batch result/unstarted verification; no result-prefix sweep
